genome.extract.gene_note: Extract Selected Gene: whole annotated gene span, including UTRs and introns. No extra sequence is added upstream of the gene.
genome.extract.coding_note: Extract Selected Gene: span from the first to last coding base across the gene's transcripts, with introns retained. The flank starts before the first coding base on the gene's 5' side, NOT before the transcription start site (TSS). This is not whole-gene-plus-promoter extraction and may omit UTR sequence.
genome.extract.region_note: Extract Region uses only chr/start/end above and adds no flank, even if the output name contains 'promoter'. To include upstream DNA this way, decrease start on the + strand or increase end on the - strand.
genome.extract.coordinates_note: Chromosome coordinates above are 1-based, inclusive. The DNA viewer uses positions within the imported sequence; negative positions cannot reach DNA that was not imported.

agent.provider.builtin_echo.description: Offline demo system that echoes the prompt and can parse 'auto:'/'ask:' demo command lines.
agent.provider.custom_json_stdio.descrip: Template entry for an external agent process. The process receives JSON on stdin and should return JSON/text on stdout.
agent.provider.openai_gpt5_stdio.descrip: OpenAI-backed agent bridge over JSON stdio. Requires an external adapter executable and OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment.
agent.provider.codex_local_stdio.descrip: Routes Agent Assistant requests through a locally installed Codex CLI/App login. Selectable model ids are read from the local Codex model metadata cache. No OPENAI_API_KEY is needed; usage counts against the user's Codex/ChatGPT plan limits.
agent.provider.pi_local_stdio.descriptio: Routes Agent Assistant requests through a locally installed Pi CLI. GENtle starts an ephemeral process with no shell or project-file tools; optional session-approved public-web search and page reading use a GENtle-supplied restricted extension. Conversation history stays in the GENtle project. Selectable provider/model ids are read from 'pi --list-models'.
agent.provider.openai_gpt5_native.descri: Direct OpenAI API integration without external bridge binary. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY in environment (or in this system's env map).
agent.provider.anthropic_claude_sonnet_n: Direct Anthropic Claude API integration without external bridge binary. Requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in environment (or paste a session key in the GUI).
agent.provider.mistral_large_native.desc: Direct Mistral API integration without external bridge binary. Requires MISTRAL_API_KEY in environment (or paste a session key in the GUI).
agent.provider.local_llama_compat.descri: Template for local OpenAI-compatible Llama services (e.g. Ollama/Jan/Msty gateway). Keep model as 'unspecified' and select from discovered models, or set a concrete model override. API key is optional.
agent.provider.jan_local_compat_template: Template for Jan OpenAI-compatible local endpoint. Keep model as 'unspecified' and pick from discovered models or provide an explicit override.
agent.provider.msty_mlx_local_compat_tem: Template for Msty MLX/OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, including MLX Knife model servers. Keep model as 'unspecified' and pick from discovered models or provide an explicit override.
agent.provider.msty_local_compat_templat: Template for Msty OpenAI-compatible local endpoint. Keep model as 'unspecified' and pick from discovered models or provide an explicit override.
